title: Synthesis of Novel Cyclodextrin Derivatives Having Oligosaccharide Cluster
abstract: Abstract                A simple and facile method for the synthesis of novel 6-persubstituted β-cyclodextrin derivatives having a sugar cluster through a spacer arm is described. The coupling reaction of per-6-iodo-β-CD with each derivative of d-galactose (Gal) or N-acetyl-d-glucosamine (GlcNAc) smoothly proceeded and gave the corresponding cyclodextrin derivatives having seven sugar residues in excellent yields.
